title: Clothoid transition road
purpose: Lay out a road bend from a straight, a clothoid (Euler spiral) easing into a circular arc and a clothoid back, with exact Fresnel-series geometry and a coloured ribbon. Use it for roads, tracks and rails.

entry_points.name: clothoid_point
entry_points.summary: (x, y, heading) on the unit-direction clothoid at arc length s: x = integral cos(u^2 / (2 A^2)) du, y = integral sin(u^2 / (2 A^2)) du from 0 to s with A = ``scale``, heading s^2 / (2 A^2). Integrated by the power series of the Fresnel integrals (converges for every s).

entry_points.name: curvature_at
entry_points.summary: Curvature of the road centre line at distance s along the bend: rising linearly over the first clothoid, 1 / radius along the arc, falling over the second clothoid, 0 elsewhere.

entry_points.name: centre_line
entry_points.summary: Points (x, y) and headings of the road centre line, starting with a straight of length ``lead`` along +x, integrating the piecewise-linear curvature exactly segment by segment (clothoid series inside the transitions, circles on the arc).

entry_points.name: road
entry_points.summary: A flat road ribbon in the XZ plane (2D y maps to -z) with asphalt colour and white edge lines.

entry_points.name: main
entry_points.summary: Command line: write the road ribbon (.gltf or .obj) and print a JSON summary.

parameters.name: radius
parameters.meaning: Radius of the circular arc in the middle of the bend.

parameters.name: transition
parameters.meaning: Length of each clothoid, over which curvature grows linearly from 0 to 1 / radius.

parameters.name: arc_angle
parameters.meaning: Turn of the circular arc between the two clothoids.

parameters.name: step
parameters.meaning: Arc-length spacing of the road cross-sections.

contract.complexity: O(length / step) points, each a short power series

outputs.content: the road ribbon with POSITION, NORMAL and COLOR_0 (asphalt with white edge lines)
the same ribbon as Wavefront OBJ

limits: A flat road in one plane: no banking, crown or elevation profile. One left-hand bend between two straights; chain several calls for longer layouts. The series is evaluated in double precision, accurate to about 1e-10 m for transitions of a few hundred metres.
technique_references: Clothoid (Euler spiral) with curvature proportional to arc length
